description: Check if an email address can receive mail before you send: syntax, whether the domain has mail servers (MX), disposable/throwaway providers (100k+ domains), role addresses like info@ or support@, free-provider detection and typo suggestions (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Returns a deliverable / risky / undeliverable verdict. Pay per call; ask the pricing tool for a quote.
name: email_verify
title: Email address verification
